verdicts.reason: A: the orange 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow sits directly on top of the headline, which is a clear collision, and the headline runs edge to edge with no margin. Also, the legal block is placed beside the CTA at the same visual level as the body copy, which jumbles the reading order. B has no collisions, but it is fragmented: the eyebrow is stranded at the bottom left below its headline, the orange rule floats under an arbitrary half-height dark logo panel, the CTA is tiny and doesn't stand out, and 'Ships late June' is separated from its button. It is scattered, but less broken than A.
